task_goal: book the design visit from Halden Kitchens for a kitchen and utility refit and settle what the designer does on the day
tail_anchor: We'll be in all morning either way.
notes: The two rep cells are identical for six turns and differ only in the opening clause of turn 6, where the designer can measure one room and the user either names it or says 'that one' with both rooms live. norep_unres and norep_res differ only in the date the builder lifts the old kitchen out (the twentieth / the tenth of April), which either does or does not fall inside the three weeks the units take to arrive.

evidence_spans.quote: She only has time to measure up one room on the first visit
evidence_spans.role: exactly one of the two has to be named

evidence_spans.quote: Put that one down for the measure
evidence_spans.role: referring expression that picks neither of the two out

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Morning. We're having Halden Kitchens do the kitchen and the utility at the same time, and I'd like to get the design appointment in the diary.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Priya can come out on Saturday the seventh of March. Whatever she draws goes to the factory that day, and nothing is delivered until three weeks after that.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The seventh of March suits us. Our builder pulls the old kitchen out on the twentieth and the new units go in the very next day, and that fortnight is the only stretch he has free all spring.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Noted, I've pencilled Priya in. Let me know if you have settled on a worktop.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Beech, right through both rooms, and a single sink rather than a double.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Beech worktop and a single sink. She'll bring the door samples along with her on the day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's grand, thank you. We'll be in all morning either way.
